抢占式实例可以在哪个可用区优先调度？
graph_cypher:
MATCH (it:InstanceType)
WHERE it.category CONTAINS "spot" OR toLower(it.category) IN ["spot", "interruptible"]
MATCH (it)-[:CONTAINS]->(itf:InstanceTypeFamily)
MATCH (z:Zone)-[:SUPPORTS]->(itf)
RETURN DISTINCT z

q: 非全额退订要收多少比例的手续费？
按量付费实例欠费停机后数据保留多长时间？
graph_cypher:
MATCH (rp:RefundPolicy)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(:Instance)
MATCH (rp)-[:HAS_TIME_LIMIT]->(tp:TimePeriod)
WHERE 
  (rp.description CONTAINS "欠费" OR rp.description CONTAINS "overdue" OR rp.description CONTAINS "arrears" OR 
   rp.description CONTAINS "停机" OR rp.description CONTAINS "shutdown" OR rp.description CONTAINS "stop") 
  OR 
  (tp.description CONTAINS "欠费" OR tp.description CONTAINS "overdue" OR tp.description CONTAINS "arrears" OR 
   tp.description CONTAINS "停机" OR tp.description CONTAINS "shutdown" OR tp.description CONTAINS "stop") 
RETURN tp

q: 包年包月实例一次买三年的折扣是多少？
graph_cypher:
MATCH (bm:BillingMode {name: "Subscription"})
MATCH (pd:PurchaseDuration {duration: "3 years"})
MATCH (bm)-[:OFFERS_DISCOUNT]->(d:Discount)-[:APPLIES_TO_PURCHASE_DURATION]->(pd)
RETURN d, d.rate AS discount_rate

q: 按使用流量计费时，入网流量怎么收费？
graph_cypher:
MATCH (br:BillingRule)-[:CHARGES_FOR]->(td:TrafficDirection)
MATCH (br)-[:APPLIES_TO_BANDWIDTH_RANGE]->(brange:BandwidthRange)-[:HAS_PRICE]->(p:Price)
WHERE td.direction = "inbound"
RETURN br, td, brange, p
